friends are still our first and sometimes best model of someone who chooses to be always on your side.Ava, bookbear express
i like this framing from Ava. friendship exists way before we form romantic love and family obligation i.e. the relationship you choose without biological reasoning or a legal contract. it is someone that looks at you and decides that yes, i will allocate a portion of my waking hours to be with this person. yes, i will be there to pick you up from the airport.
C.S. Lewis wrote that lovers face each other absorbed in one another while friends stand side by side absorbed in something external. you become friends by caring about the same problems. this is also why I found work-friends feel so intenseyou’re literally shoulder-to-shoulder looking at the same thing for 40+ hours a week.
friendship was what taught me that love is an endurance sport with no finish line.Ava
Aristotle distinguished three kinds of philia: utility (we help each other), pleasure (we enjoy each other’s company), and virtue (we value each other’s good character and wish each other well). In Nicomachean Ethics VIII.3, the first two depend on the benefit or pleasure that sustains them. When that disappears, the friendship can dissolve.
I agree with his emphasis on character as a foundation for friendship. Caring about who someone is gives us a reason to stay when circumstances change. 1
friendships are, by their very nature, made of friction, knowing what's going on in someone's day-to-day life, making plans, rescheduling when someone gets sick, bringing over soup.Rosie Spinks, the friendship problem

we’ve optimized away the very friction that makes us, better friend, and to an extend better human. everything about predictive technologies gives us assisted living, esther perel notes, “people have easily 1000 virtual friends, but no one they can ask to feed their cat.” sheila liming also wrote an entire book on this: “hanging out is productive, and the thing that it produces is our relationships with each other.”

Karlsson frames this better than I ever could, where we “show the inside of your head in public, so people can see if they would like to live in there.” I want my site to be, a search query for people who might want to be friends.
i care a lot about my friends. i want people who can sit in a room without filling it with noise, who can be bored together without reaching for phones.
i want people to go to a beach with and watch people enjoying a day-out with their family, while acting out their conversations among ourselves.
i want people who choose to interpret someone charitably, staying inside the magic circle and participate in the game of understanding.
i want people who spontaneously decide that “ok we are going to book a trip to Dolomites and we are just going to pet cows”, while debating about the ever-lasting existential dread of cognitive deficiency.
i want people who are honest and blunt, but still be kind and be silly with.
finally, i want people who can, and will always show up, repeatedly, over time, even if it is only 8 minutes while being busy at work.
i often think about my life as being RLHF’d by the people i surround myself with, as we populate our concept of the world with them. i’m not there yet with everyone, but with the people closest to me, i’m trying.
a long friendship really is like a marriage. it takes on a shape all its own over many years, and it is an education in intimacy. like marriage, it's nearly impossible to know in the beginning what it will be at the end.Ava, some thoughts on friendship
if any of this resonates, I have a form⁠ for you to fill LOL, but otherwise I’m reachable via contact@aarnphm.xyz
